claims.text: The consumer office warned that fraudsters impersonated relief charities through messaging apps.

citations.title: SYNTHETIC consumer warning about relief impersonation
citations.excerpt: On 14 November 2024 the synthetic consumer office warned that fraudsters impersonated relief charities through messaging apps and asked for transfers to personal accounts. It advised donors to use only channels listed on an organisation's own website.
